title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 4.33 (versions follow prime numbers; 433 after 431): when she runs out of memory she sleeps by herself (her sleep sign), and who watches over her wakes her whole; her bridge is only for her author, not for her talk with her books, which made her run out of memory. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v4.33: sin memoria se duerme sola. Prototipo de investigación.
